card.name: Frequency words after a dose amount
card.fires_on: The word "twice" (or "times") right after a dose amount such as "200 mg", where a frequency like "daily" is expected next. Also fires on a number inside a dosing calculation.

modes.label: Twice after dose
modes.description: "twice" directly follows an amount in mg and leads into "daily", "a day" or "weekly".

modes.label: Times in frequency
modes.description: "times" follows a count such as "two" or "2" in a times-per-day schedule.

modes.label: Number in dose calculation
modes.description: A number inside an arithmetic dose or amount formula.
